vectors.name: emitter-valid-instance
vectors.reason: A correctly attested collision-warning instance validates.

vectors.name: emitter-actor-class-not-permitted
vectors.reason: A valid envelope cannot use an actor class outside the declaration's semantic authority set.

vectors.name: emitter-target-role-escalation-rejected
vectors.reason: An emission cannot retarget a driver-only declaration to a different occupant.

vectors.name: emitter-validity-extension-rejected
vectors.reason: Runtime validity cannot exceed the declaration-owned semantic window.

vectors.name: emitter-invalid-node-payload-rejected
vectors.reason: A structurally valid runtime envelope still has to satisfy its digest-bound node payload schema.

vectors.name: emitter-priority-injection-rejected
vectors.reason: The runtime envelope is closed; a payload-side priority override must be rejected, not ignored.

vectors.name: emitter-renderer-override-rejected
vectors.reason: Renderer selection belongs to the declaration and Translation, never to the emission.

vectors.name: emitter-unknown-algorithm-rejected
vectors.reason: Algorithm identifiers outside the fixed profile must be rejected (downgrade resistance).

vectors.name: emitter-missing-key-id-rejected
vectors.reason: An attestation without a key identity cannot be verified or revoked.

vectors.name: emitter-action-node-deferred
vectors.reason: Action is not emittable in the sia-minimal 0.4 profile.

vectors.name: renderer-valid-presented-receipt
vectors.reason: An authenticated presented receipt validates.

vectors.name: renderer-receipt-before-dispatch-rejected
vectors.reason: A receipt cannot causally precede the bound dispatch attempt.

vectors.name: renderer-cannot-issue-timeout
vectors.reason: Delivery timeout is a Coordination Runtime event; a renderer must not claim it.

vectors.name: renderer-success-carries-no-failure-reason
vectors.reason: A presented receipt with a failure reason is contradictory evidence.

vectors.name: renderer-capability-valid
vectors.reason: An attested safety-relevant capability declaration with evidence validates.

vectors.name: renderer-safety-claim-needs-evidence
vectors.reason: A renderer must not self-promote to safety_relevant without accepted evidence.

vectors.name: runtime-valid-actor-registry
vectors.reason: The signed authority registry and the instance credential binding agree.

vectors.name: runtime-revoked-credential-rejected
vectors.reason: An otherwise valid signature cannot authorize an actor whose credential is revoked.

vectors.name: runtime-valid-context-policy
vectors.reason: The signed policy is bound consistently through declarations and lifecycle artifacts.

vectors.name: runtime-unknown-context-must-be-worst-case
vectors.reason: Unknown context must not reduce protection below a known risky state.

vectors.name: runtime-valid-signed-catalog
vectors.reason: The published catalog has unique nodes and consistent policy bindings.

vectors.name: runtime-duplicate-catalog-node-rejected
vectors.reason: A signed catalog cannot contain two declarations with the same canonical node ID.

vectors.name: runtime-valid-alert-declaration
vectors.reason: The published collision-warning declaration validates.

vectors.name: runtime-alert-must-never-block
vectors.reason: An applicable critical Alert cannot be silently droppable by context policy.

vectors.name: runtime-coalesce-requires-ttl-and-key
vectors.reason: Unbounded or keyless coalescing is non-conformant retention.

vectors.name: runtime-empty-trust-contract-rejected
vectors.reason: A declaration without trust requirements must not enter a catalog.

vectors.name: runtime-valid-dispatch-attempt
vectors.reason: The attempt binds an eligible selected renderer and a bounded deadline.

vectors.name: runtime-dispatch-to-unselected-renderer-rejected
vectors.reason: Coordination cannot dispatch to a renderer that Translation did not select.

vectors.name: runtime-timeout-is-not-an-occupant-action
vectors.reason: A response timeout must carry runtime evidence, never verified-input evidence.

vectors.name: runtime-response-before-presentation-rejected
vectors.reason: The occupant response window cannot open before a presented delivery receipt exists.

vectors.name: runtime-response-authority-override-rejected
vectors.reason: A response artifact cannot widen the declaration-owned driver-only authority.

vectors.name: runtime-context-requires-all-core-axes
vectors.reason: A decision snapshot missing a core axis is not a valid basis for policy.

vectors.name: runtime-stale-context-observation-rejected
vectors.reason: Each context axis has a policy-owned freshness window.

vectors.name: runtime-unoccupied-target-rejected
vectors.reason: A driver-targeted render plan cannot bind a snapshot in which no driver is present.

vectors.name: runtime-retention-past-semantic-validity-rejected
vectors.reason: Retention TTL never extends the interaction's semantic validity.

vectors.name: runtime-audit-chain-needs-predecessor
vectors.reason: A hash-linked audit record validates; chain-position invariants are covered by the invariant tests.
